name: hw12_08_get_trend
description: Test 8. Points (0, 0), (10, 10), (20, 20) relative to from = 5000: slope 1, intercept 0. At 24 bits every step rounds to single: sx = sy = sqrt(66.666664) = 8.164966, r = 1.0000001 (0x3F800001), slope the same, intercept (30 - 30.000004) / 3 = -1.2715658e-06 (0xB5AAAAAB); at 53 bits slope 1 (0x3F800000) and intercept 1.18e-15 stored to float (0x26AAAAAB). A single point: slope 0, intercept its value. A missing key or an empty series: false. Precision (HW3): points (0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 4) give slope 1.5 and intercept 5/6; with every operation of 4.7 done as an IEEE single operation (24 bits) the results are 0x3FBFFFFF and 0x3F555558, as IEEE doubles (53 bits) stored to float 0x3FC00000 and 0x3F555555 (worked with plain single and double arithmetic in the order of 4.7).
